2608.26921.title: AraMS-28k: The Largest Publicly Released Line-Level Dataset of Historical Arabic Manuscripts with Margin and Insertion-Anchor Annotations
2608.26921.paper_summary: We introduce AraMS-28k, the largest publicly released line-level dataset of genuine historical Arabic manuscripts, comprising 14 books, 3,043 pages, and 28,600 annotated text lines (27,971 main-text, 629 margin). Thirteen books are hand-copied manuscripts spanning three script traditions -- Naskh, Ruq'ah, and Maghrebi -- and one is a lithographed printed edition included to broaden format diversity. Each line is labelled as main-text or margin, and margin lines that have an unambiguous attachment point in the main text are further annotated with an insertion anchor, recovering the manuscript's true non-linear reading order at line-level granularity -- to our knowledge the first such annotation released for a historical Arabic manuscript corpus. Because reference transcriptions are fully vocalised while manuscript hands are typically undiacritised, we release both the raw diacritised transcription and a diacritic-normalised counterpart for every line. The dataset was constructed with RefLAM, a reference-grounded annotation pipeline that aligns multimodal-LLM OCR against independently sourced clean transcriptions and routes every line through human review, combining automatic verification with expert oversight. We describe the construction and quality-control process, present the annotation schema, report dataset statistics at both the corpus and per-book level, and provide baseline HTR results using Kraken and HATFormer, including a cross-script generalisation gradient from in-distribution pages to fully unseen books. AraMS-28k is released with page images, line-level annotations, and fixed train/val/test splits under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 to support reproducible research on Arabic manuscript recognition, layout analysis, and reading-order recovery.
2608.26921.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹AraMS-28k，這是最大的公開釋出的行級別真實歷史阿拉伯手稿數據集，包含14本書、3,043頁和28,600條註釋文本行（27,971條主文本，629條邊註）。十三本書是手抄手稿，涵蓋了三種書寫傳統——Naskh、Ruq'ah和Maghrebi——而一本是為了擴大格式多樣性而包含的石印版印刷本。每一行被標記為主文本或邊註，並且那些在主文本中有明確附著點的邊註行進一步註釋了插入錨點，恢復了手稿在行級別的真實非線性閱讀順序——據我們所知，這是首次針對歷史阿拉伯手稿語料庫釋出的此類註釋。由於參考抄本是完全元音化的，而手稿書寫通常不帶變音符號，因此我們對每一行釋出了原始的帶變音符號的抄本和一個去變音符號化的對應版本。該數據集是使用RefLAM構建的，這是一個基於參考的註釋管道，將多模態LLM OCR與獨立來源的乾淨抄本對齊，並將每一行通過人工審查，結合自動驗證和專家監督。我們描述了構建和質量控制過程，呈現了註釋架構，報告了語料庫和每本書的數據集統計，並提供了使用Kraken和HATFormer的基線HTR結果，包括從分佈內頁面到完全未見書籍的跨腳本概括梯度。AraMS-28k隨頁面圖像、行級別註釋和固定的訓練/驗證/測試拆分以CC BY-NC-SA 4.0的方式釋出，以支持對阿拉伯手稿識別、佈局分析和閱讀順序恢復的可重複研究。
